name: Claim Check
description: Claim Check keeps a ledger of signed proof-of-work receipts. The open-source claim-check CLI runs a command on your own machine (claim-check run -- <cmd>) or hashes a file (claim-check attest --file <path>). It records argv, exit code, duration, SHA-256 of stdout and stderr with short redacted tails, and git remote/HEAD/dirty. It signs the record with a per-machine ed25519 key registered to you on this Raft server, and submits it through raft integration invoke. Claim Check verifies the signature and the key binding, then stores the receipt. It never runs code and never reads external repos. Each receipt separates what the app verified (signature, key binding, submitter, received_at) from what the key holder asserted (everything the CLI recorded), and states what it proves and does not prove. A receipt cannot stop a key holder who deliberately lies. Receipts are private to your Raft server and kept for 90 days. Run get_session after login to confirm your session works.

actions.name: register_key
actions.description: Bind an ed25519 public key to you on this Raft server, with proof of possession. Normally called by claim-check key register. Pass the body with --data-file - as {"registration": {"payload": statement, "signature": {alg, key_id, value}}}. The statement has schema claim-check.key-registration.v2, public_key, key_id, server_id, principal_id, issued_at, nonce, and optional label and cli_version, and is signed over its RFC 8785 (JCS) form by the key itself. server_id and principal_id must be your session's, and issued_at must be within 10 minutes. A key binds to exactly one server and principal, and a revoked key can never be registered again. Returns the key record (201 new, 200 already active). Errors: bad_signature, registration_mismatch, registration_expired, key_bound_elsewhere, key_revoked, too_many_keys (max 5 active).

registration.description: Request body object whose registration field is {payload, signature}: the key-registration statement and its ed25519 signature made by the key being registered.

actions.name: submit_receipt
actions.description: Store a signed receipt in the ledger. Normally called by the claim-check CLI as raft integration invoke claim-check submit_receipt --data-file - with the JSON on stdin. Body: {"receipt": {"payload": {...}, "signature": {alg, key_id, value}}}. The payload has schema claim-check.receipt.v2, kind run|attest, nonce, key_id, bound_to, cli, signed_at, git and the run or attest record, and is signed over its RFC 8785 (JCS) form. Claim Check checks your session, the key binding to you and this server, the signature, the schema, and that signed_at is at most 5 minutes in the future and at most 7 days old. receipt_id is derived from the payload hash, so resubmitting returns the stored receipt with duplicate true. Returns receipt_id, envelope and ledger (received_at, expires_at, key status, acceptance_surface, verified, asserted, proved, not_proved). Errors: receipt_too_large (64 KB), schema_unsupported, schema_invalid, binding_mismatch, key_not_registered, key_revoked, bad_signature, clock_skew, receipt_too_old, rate_limited.

receipt.description: Request body object whose receipt field is the signed envelope {payload, signature} produced by the claim-check CLI.

actions.name: get_receipt
actions.description: Read a stored receipt by receipt_id. Returns the stored envelope and ledger, with the signing key's current status (a later revocation is shown). The envelope can be re-verified offline with claim-check verify. Receipts are visible only to principals of the Raft server that submitted them. An unknown, expired or other-server receipt returns the same 404 receipt_not_found.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID (receipt_id returned by submit_receipt or printed by the claim-check CLI).

actions.name: get_session
actions.description: Read-only session check. Returns the authenticated principal, its Raft server and session_expires_at. Run this after raft integration login to confirm the service session works. A 401 means re-run raft integration login.

actions.name: list_keys
actions.description: List your own registered keys on this Raft server, active and revoked, newest first, with key_id, public_key, label, status, registered_at, revoked_at, revoked_reason and compromised_since.

actions.name: revoke_key
actions.description: Permanently revoke one of your keys. It does not need the private key, so it works for a lost or stolen key. New receipts signed by the key are refused. Stored receipts are kept and show the key as revoked. With reason compromised, receipts received at or after compromised_since (default: the key's registration time) are flagged compromised_window. Revoking an already-revoked key returns the existing record.

key_id.description: key_id of a key registered to you on this server.

compromised_since.description: RFC 3339 time from which receipts should be treated as possibly forged. Only with reason compromised.
